issues.description: Console warning: container does not have a non-static position for scroll offset calculation. This is a non-blocking warning but indicates a layout/positioning issue that could affect scroll behavior in some components.
issues.root_cause: A component using a scroll-offset library (e.g., react-scroll, framer-motion scroll, or a custom hook) is mounted inside a statically-positioned container div. The container CSS likely lacks 'position: relative' or equivalent.

issues.description: page:mount event fires twice in console logs (ts: 1776404288740 and 1776404288742). This suggests the auth page component mounts twice, possibly due to React StrictMode double-invoking effects or a duplicate route render.
issues.root_cause: React StrictMode in development intentionally double-invokes effects, or there is a duplicate analytics/telemetry call in useEffect without a cleanup or guard. If this is not StrictMode, it could be a route misconfiguration rendering the component twice.

fixes.reason: Adds non-static positioning to resolve the scroll offset console warning from whichever scroll utility is used inside the auth layout.
Adding an empty dependency array ensures the page:mount event fires only once on initial mount, preventing duplicate telemetry events caused by effect re-runs.
